description:
Job Details: Basic Qualifications: 
 * 7+ years web development experience which includes the programming/ development of web applications. 
 
 Minimum Qualifications: 
 
 * At least 6 years experience in Java, J2EE, Servlets, XML, and Web Services development 
 * At least 6 years experience in advanced Oracle SQL & PL/SQL development 
 * At least 6 years experience in diagnosing and/or triaging application issues deployed in Unix 
 * At least 4 years experience in 2 or more of the following scripting languages: CGI, Perl, Windows Scripting, & UNIX Shell Scripts 
 * Demonstrated experience in object-oriented development, design methodologies, and design patterns * Demonstrated experience in 2 or more of the following IDEs/Tools: Eclipse, Intelli-J, Maven, TOAD, Introscope, Splunk, and Oracle Developer/Enterprise Manag er. 



 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
